title: SnowInAllBiomes
description: This is a mod that allows the snow function to work in every single biome, its also configurable to add the highest layers you want, this is perfect for a christmas world. Only made as the other snow mods that do this are extremely outdated and dont work.
body:
Allows snow to fall in every biome and lets the player select a maximum layer ammount to prevent snow filling the world. Perfect for a christmas or winter world.

Known issues
If you have sound mods then when you are in a non snowy biome you may occasionally hear rain noise when its snowing, this is because in the newer versions of minecraft the easiest way to make the snow work in all biomes was to replace the rain with snow but sometime other mods still play rain noises.

may work with other versions but this mod is made for 1.21.10 so expect issues if you try on other versions.
